summary: As of 2026-09-22, Docker Desktop 4.92.0 (2026-09-21) is the newest GA release and is newer than pin 4.86.0. Windows always-on stack should review before any upgrade: published ports staying unreachable after a momentarily busy host port, WSL2 cross-distro bind-mount proxy serving stale/incomplete host dirs, WSL disk-image and kernel-module start hangs, plus remaining 4.91.0 abrupt-shutdown network-DB / Compose Resource Saver rebuild and 4.90.0 WinGet install-settings.json hang.
relevant_notes: 4.92.0 all platforms: published ports stayed unreachable for the life of the container when the host port was momentarily busy. Directly relevant to this always-on stack: endurance-coach 5432/8000/8080 and media ports (Jellyfin 8096, Caddy 443, Sonarr 8989, Radarr 7878, Prowlarr 9696, Navidrome 4533, slskd 5030) during heal/restart races.

4.92.0 Windows: WSL 2 cross-distro bind-mount proxy could serve stale or incomplete directory contents for host paths on slow-to-mount drives (example: Storage Pool volumes). Applies to media/*arr bind mounts and endurance-coach host mounts (${USERPROFILE}/.garminconnect, ${USERPROFILE}/.endurance-coach).

4.92.0 Windows: Docker Desktop retried the WSL engine indefinitely without reporting an error when WSL could not load its own kernel modules. Can leave the engine appearing stuck instead of failing closed.

4.92.0 Windows: a misleading error claimed the WSL disk image had been deleted when WSL could not open it while registering the Docker Desktop distribution. Related to prior 4.91.0 Starting... hang when the disk-image path was inaccessible.

4.92.0 Windows: Windows 10 hosts with inbox wsl.exe saw a raw error instead of the prompt to update WSL. Relevant if this host still uses inbox WSL (configure_docker_wsl_limits.ps1 also runs wsl --update).

4.92.0 Windows: single-file bind mounts on Docker VMM were broken; the 'not shared from the host' error now points at the containing directory. Relevant only if this host uses Docker VMM rather than WSL 2.
4.92.0 all platforms: Send Diagnostics hung or showed an unhelpful error when a proxy blocked the upload. Proxy-related; this host also uses ExpressVPN.
4.92.0 Windows: disk image location moves to a different drive always failed (desktop-feedback#548/#550). Avoid mid-move disk-image relocations on this host.

4.92.0 security: containerd updated to v2.3.5, addressing CVE-2026-53495. Also ships Docker Buildx v0.37.1. No Engine or Compose bump in 4.92.0 (those remain Engine v29.8.0 / Compose v5.5.1 from 4.91.0).

4.91.0 all platforms: a corrupt Docker network database, usually from an abrupt shutdown, prevented Docker Engine from starting and left a factory reset as the only recovery option. Directly relevant to this always-on host (configure_power_outage_hardening.ps1, post_boot_stack_recovery.ps1, restart_docker_desktop.ps1).

4.91.0 all platforms: Docker Compose rebuilt locally-built images on every Resource Saver wake (docker/desktop-feedback#507). endurance-coach compose uses build: . / image: endurance-coach:latest for api and mcp.
4.91.0 all platforms: the VM could shut down unexpectedly when idle timeout was set to 0. Always-on power hardening disables sleep; confirm Desktop idle/auto-pause is not 0-timeouting the engine.
4.91.0 all platforms: Docker Desktop sometimes took five extra minutes to report the engine as stopped when the VM stopped unexpectedly. Affects restart/unless-stopped recovery timing.
4.91.0 Windows: Docker Desktop stayed on Starting... indefinitely when WSL could not access the disk image location; it now reports the access failure with guidance instead of a generic WSL error.

4.90.0 Windows: startup hang on 'Starting' after a WinGet upgrade when install-settings.json has conflicting engine settings. Directly relevant to scripts/update_docker_desktop.ps1 (winget upgrade --id Docker.DockerDesktop).
4.90.0 / 4.89.0 Windows: Docker Desktop could fail to start after an ungraceful shutdown left a stuck socket. Relevant to power-loss recovery.
4.90.0 Windows: a failing third-party WSL plugin (example: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint WSL plugin) was reported as a missing Docker Desktop disk instead of naming the plugin that blocked WSL.

4.90.0 all platforms: bind-mount root intermittently reported ownership 0:0 (git 'detected dubious ownership'); repeatedly replacing files on a shared folder leaked VM disk space; VirtioFS renameat2(RENAME_EXCHANGE) overwrote the target; mmap() of a Synchronized File Share file failed. Applies to endurance-coach host mounts and media/*arr bind mounts.
4.90.0 security: Kind cloud provider image v0.7.0 addresses CVE-2026-46595 and CVE-2026-39834. Low priority unless this host uses Kind / Docker Offload Kubernetes.

4.89.0 Resource Saver background container/image polling no longer wakes the engine. 4.88.0: HTTP 500 on startup/wake when the engine socket existed but was not yet listening; corrupted ~/.docker/daemon.json (null bytes after crash/power-loss) auto-recovers to defaults; docker ps port bindings include [::1]; Docker VMM inbound throughput regression (~0.3 GB/s) fixed.

4.87.0 Windows: Store-installed WSL repeatedly prompted for wsl --update (also used by configure_docker_wsl_limits.ps1); misleading proxy errors named the destination instead of the unreachable upstream; Resource Saver / disk-limit UI fixes for Hyper-V and Docker VMM.

Pin 4.86.0 already includes unless-stopped / container-stop honoring on engine shutdown, VirtioFS AF_UNIX bidirectional sockets, OS-configured proxy Offload fix, and CVE-2026-17106 (docker container cp destination escape).
recommended_actions: Do not bump the Version default in scripts/update_docker_desktop.ps1 from this alert. Leave the pin at 4.86.0 until a human reviews 4.92.0 on this Windows host.
Do not change compose files, recovery scripts, or other stack config from this alert.

Treat 4.92.0 as the review target: published ports staying dead after a briefly busy host port, WSL2 bind-mount proxy serving stale/incomplete host dirs, WSL disk-image/kernel-module start hangs, and containerd CVE-2026-53495.

Still review remaining 4.91.0 items if upgrading past the pin: abrupt-shutdown network-DB recovery (was factory-reset-only), Compose rebuilds of endurance-coach on Resource Saver wake, idle-timeout 0 VM shutdown.
Before any upgrade, snapshot or inspect %APPDATA%\Docker\install-settings.json (and the all-users copy if present) so a WinGet hang on conflicting engine settings (still in 4.90.0) can be diagnosed.

If upgrading later, run scripts/update_docker_desktop.ps1 only after a planned window; expect Docker restart plus heal_full_stack.ps1. Watch for 'Starting' hang after winget, published ports that never become reachable, stale media/*arr bind-mount listings, stuck-socket or corrupt-network-DB startup after power loss, and unexpected VM stop when idle timeout is 0.

After any upgrade, confirm media/*arr and endurance-coach postgres/api/mcp (restart: unless-stopped) come back without a compose rebuild loop, published ports 5432/8000/8080 still bind, and host bind-mount contents/ownership on ~/.garminconnect and ~/.endurance-coach are complete and not 0:0.

If WSL fails to start, check disk-image path access, WSL kernel-module load, and named third-party WSL plugins (Defender) rather than a missing Docker disk. Kind CVEs can be ignored unless Kind/Offload Kubernetes is in use.
Use Automation Watchboard (yellow Update) as the cue to apply or skip 4.92.0 in Cursor.
